name: Deore XT I-spec shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 220 g for the complete left/right SL-M780-B-I I-spec control pair. The table explicitly states pair; band-mounted model weights are not transferred and no side is doubled.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2015 TSS manual, PDF/printed page 26: XT SL-M780-B-I I-spec complete pair 220 g; manufacturer explicitly calls FD-M785-E2 and FD-M786-D direct mount and assigns 127 g / 146 g respectively
